messages:
jordan: starting blue/green swap now for router v3 -> v4 in eu-west1. plan: shadow traffic for 2m, then 10% warm, 50% at 10m, full at 30m. cookie affinity enabled. please hold all other changes.
michelle: ack. release notes posted to the releases doc. will watch p50/p95 and error rate.
ryan: one ask — can we pin admin routes to v3 during warm to avoid auth churn? add header-route: X-Admin=pin-v3 if possible.
jordan: yes, pinning admin via header rule. command I ran: `routerctl routes add --match "header:X-Admin=pin-v3" --backend v3-admin --region eu-west1`
lina: noted. kube drain for green nodes scheduled after 50% cutover window. grace=60s.
deploy-bot: [deploy] deployment v4 started for service router in eu-west1. task id: d-171777-44. streaming: shadow started -> OK.
ops-oncall: seeing slight increase in p95 for text-generation path (+120ms) but error rate stable. holding at shadow.
michelle: can we enable request sampling for traces at 10% so we can compare traces v3/v4?
jordan: done, sampling flag set: `--trace-sample=0.1` via rollout config.
deploy-bot: 10% warm traffic applied. current weights: v3=90 v4=10.
ops-oncall: getting small spike in 5xx for v4 on connection pool exhaustion (backend: embedder). raising circuit-breaker threshold might help.
ryan: suggestion: reduce v4 concurrency to 8 and enable prefix cache bypass for long prompts while we investigate.
jordan: making adjustments: `routerctl set backend v4 --concurrency=8` and `runtime flag prefix_cache_bypass=true` for v4.
ops-oncall: after changes p95 back down ~40ms. but latency variance still higher than v3. recommend hold at 10% for another 20m while we monitor.
michelle: team consensus to hold. I'll update the release note and pause cutover timers.
jordan: agreed. pausing automated ramp. manual approval required to continue.
ops-oncall: around 1717777800 saw a small surge in CPU steal on the embedder instances, correlates with v4 requests. investigating underlying node placement.
jordan: ok switching traffic to fallback pool for embedder for v4: `infractl reroute embedder --pool fallback-eu`.
deploy-bot: traffic reroute executed. (task d-171777-44)
ops-oncall: after fallback reroute we see error rate drop but p95 still ~30ms above baseline. at this point i'd recommend rollback if we can't get parity in 10m.
michelle: +1 to rollback if parity not reached. we need predictable latency for this release.
jordan: rolling decision: initiate rollback of v4 to v3 for router in eu-west1. rollback command: `deployctl rollback d-171777-44 --to-version v3 --region eu-west1`
deploy-bot: [rollback] rollback d-171777-44 initiated. restoring weights to v3=100 v4=0.
ops-oncall: monitoring now. early signals look good, p95 back to baseline within 90s.
deploy-bot: [rollback] complete. deployment d-171777-44 marked rolled-back. notes: revert due to increased latency variance on v4; follow-up ticket created: INF-4821.
jordan: thanks all. next steps: postmortem with infra + runtime teams, dial in embedder pool config and kernel selection for v4, then reattempt canary with smaller concurrency and more aggressive prefix caching.
michelle: creating the postmortem draft, cc @runtime-team.
ryan: filing a short infra action to avoid co-locating v4 embedder pods with high-steal nodes.
lina: i'll schedule a quiet window for the next attempt and pre-warm pools.
jordan: closing thread — thanks for the quick ops. :thumbsup:
